integrity: Integral statement proved symbolically by relative augmented chains and primitive lattice inclusion; 9030 signed-chain comparisons and 26 direct quotient-chain cases are corroborative, not an all-parameter proof. Originality remains subject to unindexed equivalents.
scientific_limitations: Existing nonequivariant multipartite sphere counts are explicitly not claimed. The result concerns full graph automorphisms and at least three nonempty parts. Geometric quotient homology is determined rationally, not integrally; equivariant homotopy type is not classified.
title: Integral symmetry modules and automorphism quotients of multipartite higher independence complexes
